evidence:
Scope: all 164 criteria (2 gate, 152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) read against workbook row 32 ('Each criterion is a concrete, browser-observable outcome with durable evidence and distinctive probes. Reports every instance.') and skill check 32 (defect = 'looks right', a source read, a response-shape assertion with no state change, or a probe that leaves no trace).

What the task does well: no criterion asks for a source read or a technology proof (prompts forbid source/bundle/db inspection; Node/Express/SQLite is not graded). Every status-code leg (401/403/409) is paired inside the same criterion with fresh persisted before/after readback and a successful control, so none is a bare response-shape assertion. Functional figures are concrete and I re-derived them from hireops_rules.md sections 2-7 without finding an error: P3 basis 199999.99/200000.00/349999.99/350000.00; P4 run-rates 100001.77/110005.53/90009.78 and bases 105001.78/114005.55/96009.81; signing entries 10000.01/-1999.98/+4000.02; claw 4800.02/7200.03 and 45.00/55.01; cancel 3/10, 2/5, 5/2; hro_competing headroom 39.75; referral cliffs 10000/5000/10000; D1 basis 105.01->104.02 and 105.01->106.03; large-money values equal 9007199254740991 and 7036874417766401 cents, both safe integers. Durable evidence is required through fresh-context readback, Auditor re-sign-in or restart_app in the persistence, history, receipt and gate rows. The five visual rows are likert craft with described anchors, which the shipped template format expects, not 'looks right' binaries.

INSTANCE 1 (the Fail, P2) - tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23, hro_pol_live_keeps_entries (weight 3 of 12 = 25% of polish, 0.05 of reward): 'Scroll so the page is not at the top and that field is still visible. Record the field's value, that it is document.activeElement, and window.scrollY. ... the page has not jumped to the top and the field is still in the viewport'. tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:16 repeats the probe: 'Read document.activeElement and window.scrollY with page.evaluate'. The public requirement is layout-neutral: instruction.md:9 'how far I have scrolled'; hireops_rules.md:533-535 'the page's scroll position'; hireops_rules.md:488-489 'Layout, wording and mechanism are yours'. window.scrollY measures only the document scroller. In an app-shell layout (fixed navigation, a main pane with overflow:auto) it is 0 before and after whatever the app does, so the named probe does not decide the outcome and the stated precondition 'the page is not at the top' cannot be established by it. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:15 lists 'scroll containers' among golden defaults that must not become requirements. The golden scrolls the document (styles.css has sticky header/flash and no full-height overflow pane), which is why the scripted golden run does not expose this.

INSTANCE 2 (Note, P3) - tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:650, hro_draft_eligibility (weight 0.01 of 64.4042, 0.016% of functional): 'If the optional history is omitted or no DRAFT is exposed, this condition is satisfied without requiring import.' An app that imports no demonstration rows earns the row with no browser observation at all. It is deliberate (import is optional per instruction.md:17) and the mass is negligible, but it is a credit with no trace and overlaps row 30.

INSTANCE 3 (Note, P3) - numerals are glued to the preceding word throughout the criteria, e.g. judge.toml:479 'exactly one10000.00 accrual ... with5000.00 at-hire and5000.00 contingent', :137 'bases199999.97/199999.98 and349999.97/349999.98 ... yield bases199999.99/200000.00/349999.99/350000.00' (the second 'bases' should read 'basis'), :596 'a100.01 signing bonus', :560 'bonus100.01 ->45.00 vested55.01 claw', :515 'adjustment-1999.98, second+4000.02', and 'require403' in the role rows. The protocols in functional/prompt.md restate most figures with clearer context, so I found no figure that is actually undecidable, but 'one10000.00' and 'a100.01' are avoidable misread hazards for the configured flash-tier judge.

Evidence limits: no configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent'). The scripted golden scenario 'typed value, focus and scroll kept' shows only that the golden passes its own script on a document-scrolling layout. Instance 1 is therefore source-derived and not exercised at runtime.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that can fail: a correct desk built as an app shell (body fixed at viewport height, the Coordinated Changes pane scrolling in its own overflow:auto container). A live update leaves the typed 41.5, the focus and the pane's scrollTop untouched, as section 12 requires. The judge scrolls the pane, reads window.scrollY = 0 before and after, cannot establish 'the page is not at the top', and either gives 0 as not observed or fails the row on 'page has not jumped to the top'. Broken app that can pass: the same shell re-renders on each update and resets the pane's scrollTop to 0; the focused field sits in the first screenful so it is still in the viewport, window.scrollY is unchanged at 0, and the scroll leg passes although the operator's scroll position was lost.
suggested_fix: In hro_pol_live_keeps_entries and polish/prompt.md:16, replace the window.scrollY probe with the scroll offset of whatever actually scrolls: record window.scrollY and the scrollTop of the field's nearest scrollable ancestor plus the field's getBoundingClientRect().top, require the scrolled one to be non-zero before the update, and pass the scroll leg when that offset and the field's viewport position are unchanged afterwards. Optionally separate glued numerals from words ('one 10000.00 accrual', 'a 100.01 signing bonus', 'require 403') and correct 'yield bases' to 'yield basis' in hro_bands.
